The *Vīrattheragāthā* (Thag 1.8) is a canonical Pali verse text located in the *Theragāthā* within the Sutta Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. It constitutes the eighth poem of the collection, situated among the single-verse compositions (*Ekakanipāta*), and represents the verse uttered by the elder (thera) Vīra [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, ten translations of the text are cataloged across eight languages, including an English rendering by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].
